shortDescription: Turkey’s economic authorities will spend two days discussing how to repay investors in 131 investment funds being liquidated after a wave of redemption failures, according to Bloomberg.The talks come after the redemption failures triggered turmoil in Turkey’s markets.

title: Turkey Holds Two-Day Talks on Repaying Investors in Liquidated Funds
